column3: One question concerning the people Jerusalem is divided into two.
“Thrush” names the final bird differently from a crane.
“Their harvest” supplies the object of gathering them away.
“Flee” specifies going into the cities; “doomed” renders silencing them.
“Enemy” supplies the referent of the horses’ possessive.
Lack of healing interprets the difficult expression concerning comfort over sorrow.
“No longer” adds a temporal qualification; “idols” specifies vanities.
